 12410:                                                 .kind = C_TYPE_POINTER,

 12412:         }
 12413:     }

 12416: 
 12417: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_conditional_expression_type(Arena* arena, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CParseResult* result, CScopeId scope,
 12418:                                                                 CTypeId left, CTypeId right, u32 left_start, u32 left_end, u32 right_start, u32 right_end)
 12419: {
 12420:     left = c_parse_auto_decay_type(result, left);
 12421:     right = c_parse_auto_decay_type(result, right);
 12422:     if (left.value >= result->type_count || right.value >= result->type_count)
 12423:     {
 12424:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 12425:     }
 12426:     CType left_value = result->types[left.value];
 12427:     CType right_value = result->types[right.value];
 12428:     if (left_value.kind == C_TYPE_NULLPTR && right_value.kind == C_TYPE_POINTER)
 12429:     {
 12430:         return right;
 12431:     }
 12432:     if (right_value.kind == C_TYPE_NULLPTR && left_value.kind == C_TYPE_POINTER)
 12433:     {
 12434:         return left;
 12435:     }
 12436:     // The pointer rules need the arms' spellings and the arithmetic ones do
 12437:     // not, so the constant walk they rest on runs only when an arm is a
 12438:     // pointer -- `condition ? 1 : 2` never pays for it.
 12439:     if (left_value.kind == C_TYPE_POINTER || right_value.kind == C_TYPE_POINTER)
 12440:     {
 12441:         return c_parse_conditional_pointer_type(arena, preprocess, result, scope, left, right, left_start, left_end, right_start, right_end);
 12442:     }
 12443:     if (left_value.kind == right_value.kind &&
 12444:         (left_value.kind == C_TYPE_STRUCT || left_value.kind == C_TYPE_UNION || left_value.kind == C_TYPE_ENUM))
 12445:     {
 12446:         CTypeId left_unqualified = c_parse_unqualified_type(result, left);
 12447:         CTypeId right_unqualified = c_parse_unqualified_type(result, right);
 12448:         if (c_parse_types_compatible(arena, result, preprocess, left_unqualified, right_unqualified))
 12449:         {
 12450:             CType qualifiers = {
 12451:                 .is_const = left_value.is_const || right_value.is_const,
 12452:                 .is_volatile = left_value.is_volatile || right_value.is_volatile,
 12453:                 .is_restrict = left_value.is_restrict || right_value.is_restrict,
 12454:                 .is_atomic = left_value.is_atomic || right_value.is_atomic,
 12455:             };
 12456:             return (qualifiers.is_const || qualifiers.is_volatile || qualifiers.is_restrict || qualifiers.is_atomic)
 12457:                        ? c_parse_add_qualified_type(result, left_unqualified, qualifiers)
 12458:                        : left_unqualified;
 12459:         }
 12460:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 12461:     }
 12462:     if (left.value == right.value)
 12463:     {
 12464:         return left;
 12465:     }
 12466:     return c_parse_expression_arithmetic_type(result, preprocess.target, left, right);
 12467: }
 12468: 
 12469: // Names resolve to intern ids through the borrowed preprocess table; a parse
 12470: // without one (hand-built tests) keeps every symbol 0 and the lookups below
